notes:
CRM notes / call snippets:
- Topline: large fintech security stack, processing regulated PII (payments KYC). High priority: cannot allow provider to have unencrypted master keys.
- KMS/HSM: want support for AWS KMS (multi-region CMKs), Azure Key Vault (EKM/Managed HSM), and GCP KMS. Primary ask: BYOK with customer-managed CMKs and HSM attestation.
- Quote from Head of Security: "We can't have Redwood hold plaintext keys or any unwrapped CEKs. Keys must live in our KMS/HSM and any unwrap ops must be auditable."
- Technical asks captured: envelope encryption with local CEK cache TTL, CloudTrail integration for KMS API calls, support for EKM endpoints, ability to rotate keys without downtime, and proof that Redwood private control plane never persists raw key material.
- Perf question: potential latency impact when every token decrypt requires HSM roundtrip — want async envelope cache and local secure enclave for CEK caching; will test in POC.
- Compliance: require audit log forwarding, retention controls for request/response metadata, SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence. Also data residency in us-east-1 and eu-west-1 for specific workloads.
- Legal: BYOK import policy — they require clear liability language. Need sample SOW and encryption appendix.
- Next docs asked: KMS integration design diagram, sample key policy for AWS CMK, Azure Managed HSM attestation checklist, and perf baseline script. Links to drive deck and security SOW provided.
- Soft win signal: engineering liked the rollout/fallback model for private; procurement needs final pricing and support SLA for Dedicated fallback.
- Typical CRM shorthand: "sec wants HSM attestation + no plain keys. legal: BYOK contract. se: run envelope cache perf test"
